hook: WHEN WILL YOU MARRY ME? When will you marry me?
transcript: When will you marry me? I don't know. Everyone is getting married. Why aren't you marrying me? I'm waiting for the right moment. What does the right moment mean? I don't know, it's a big decision. We need to get it right. That's bullshit, Kevin. You can never get it right. You have to pick your person and you make it right. Am I not the person you want to make it right with? You are. Okay then. I'm a size six, and I like emerald shaped diamonds.
